title: Payments Credited Toward the Previous Bill of a Payment Arrangements Account
content:
*Billing department note — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)*

**Rule.** The payments credited toward the previous bill, when an installment is billed, follow the standing of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account on the bill date:

| Account standing | Payments credited toward the previous bill |
|---|---|
| on cash-only status on the bill date | only the month's payments through office cash, money order, online card, phone (IVR) card and payment kiosk |
| not on cash-only status, with a payment returned in that month | the month's payments less the returned amounts |
| any other account | the month's payments as posted |

"The month" is the month ending on the bill date. An account is on cash-only status on the bill date when its cash-only date runs to the bill date or later. Payments and returns are read from the payments posted on the service account.

**Condition — judgement — result (hypothetical month: $50.00 office cash, $120.00 mailed check, a $120.00 return)**

1. Cash-only on the bill date → only the cash-channel payment counts → $50.00 credited.
2. Not cash-only, return in the month → $170.00 less $120.00 → $50.00 credited.
3. Not cash-only, the same payments and the return posted two months earlier → no return in the month → $170.00 credited.

On a cash-only account the first line governs whether or not a payment was returned in the month; the second line is read only for an account not on cash-only status.
